mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity (product_id, name, total_quantity, remaining_quantity, starts_at, ends_at) VALUES (#{productId}, #{name}, #{totalQuantity}, #{remainingQuantity}, #{startsAt}, #{endsAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, product_id, name, total_quantity, remaining_quantity, starts_at, ends_at FROM activity WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE activity SET remaining_quantity = remaining_quantity + #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
